header_gap.symptom: setTexture 00676890, getTextureSize 00676750 and createTextureProxy 00676aa0 are byte-identical in size to the originals (163/163, 315/315, 127/127) and score 99, differing in exactly ONE instruction.
header_gap.decoded_difference: they load their virtual from [eax+0x18] - vtable slot 6 - while the compiled code loads [eax+0xc] - slot 3. A byte-offset-aligned instruction diff of setTexture against 00676890 confirms every other instruction matches (the remaining "differences" are relocation placeholders: push 0x7dc7c8, the call rel32s and the IAT call dword ptr [0x8021ac]).
header_gap.root_cause: the virtual being loaded is RBX::TextureProxyBase::resolve. The June 2008 client was built against the 2008 interface in native-headers/RbxGraphics/TextureProxyBase2008.h, whose slots are 0 dtor, 1 setIntProperty, 2 getIntProperty, 3 setFloatProperty, 4 getFloatProperty, 5 getSize, 6 resolve, 7 shade - with Render::TextureProxy adding slot 8 getIfResolved (see native-headers/RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h, which names those slots and cites vtable 0082d140). The vendor tools/rbxgs/Client/RbxGraphics/include/RbxGraphics/TextureProxyBase.h is a LATER, SMALLER interface (0 dtor, 1 getSize), which puts resolve at slot 3.
header_gap.why_it_cannot_be_fixed_locally: both the shared native-headers/RbxGraphics/Adorn.h AND the vendor copy "#include \"RbxGraphics/TextureProxyBase.h\"", and AppDraw/AdornG3D.h pulls the vendor Adorn.h. Including TextureProxyBase2008.h alongside any of them fails with C2011 (RBX::TextureProxyBase class type redefinition), verified by a compile attempt (run 20261107-031718-965d94b7). A local replica of the Adorn and AdornG3D declarations bound to the 2008 texture interface is possible but duplicates two shared interfaces, so it is left as an owner decision rather than done unilaterally.
header_gap.owner_action: supply an Adorn interface (or an AdornG3D header) bound to the 2008 TextureProxyBase. The three bodies already exist and are unchanged - they are the overlay originals - so the only missing piece is the correct base layout. Re-add the three addresses to the manifest afterwards.
header_gap.supporting_detail: Render::TextureProxy in the 2008 header is laid out at +0x30 texture, +0x34 loaded, +0x38 textureManager, +0x3c tiled, +0x40 root, +0x44 shadeTexture, +0x48 shadeColor (allocation size 0x54), which matches the ctor traces quoted in that header.

convention_note: the packaged tree deliberately keeps the 2008 interface in non-colliding *-2008.h names because the vendor paths carry later revisions; existing units that need the 2008 texture layout (native-classes/TextureProxyRender.cpp, TextureProxyRenderNew.cpp, RenderMaterial.cpp, TextureProxyBase2008.cpp) include "RenderLib/TextureProxy2008.h" and therefore never include Adorn.h. AdornG3D is the awkward case because its own class declaration arrives through AppDraw/AdornG3D.h, which drags in the small interface.
